heroes-die:
Verse 1
What happens when the world grows cold
And I’m already growing old
What happens when my father dies
And I finally see through all his lies

When I try to do a little good
They still treat me like they always would
When the black knight rides his tired steed
Just to see if the white knight bleeds

Pre-Chorus
Why should I be the one to lie
When I’m already dead inside

Chorus
They say the good die young
The noble never did exist
It’s always someone else to blame
Just shake your head and clench your fist

Verse 2
What happens when the world grows cold
And I'm already to old
Do your children pay the toll
And then you ask me why
Like you never watched the heroes die

They never let them learn to fly
They never even let them try
Then you cry

Even though you’re the poison
You still blame the wine
They could have made it all turn out fine

Pre-Chorus 2
You call it fate, you call it time
You pour the poison, blame the wine

Chorus
They say the good die young
The noble never did exist
It’s always someone else to blame
Just shake your head and clench your fist

What happens when the world grows cold
And I’m already too old

Bridge
I’m not angry, I’m just tired
Of watching everything decay
I’m not broken, I’m just empty
And running out of things to say

Final Chorus
They say the good die young
The noble never did exist
It’s always someone else to blame
Just shake your head and clench your fist

What happens when the world grows cold
And I’m already too old

Outro
When the world grows cold
And I’m already too old
the-best-i-am:
Verse 1
Some days I wish it all was over
If I were that lucky, maybe I’d be free
Other days I look at you and know it
You don’t have to say it, you still choose me

If I could sing, I’d write you a song
But my voice was never worth much anyway
So I’ll settle for the best I can do
Just show up and love you every day

Pre-Chorus
‘Cause I’m not a hero, I’m not that strong
But I know where I belong

Chorus
And the best that I am is you
Yeah the best that I am is you
I don’t have much, but I do my best
And every broken part I lose
When I’m standing here next to you
Yeah the best that I am is you

Verse 2
Some days I wake up ready to conquer the world
Some days I’m just trying to make it through
But every road I’ve ever walked
Always somehow leads me back to you

Pre-Chorus
And I don’t know how you do what you do
But you make me something new

Chorus
‘Cause the best that I am is you
Yeah the best that I am is you
I don’t have much, but I do my best
And every broken part I lose
When I’m standing here next to you
Yeah the best that I am is you

Bridge
So baby, let’s reminisce
We’ve got a thousand good memories
And when the world comes crashing down
I’ll be right there standing next to you

So let’s not be enemies
Let’s not be enemies, no
Some things are deeper than words can go
And I hope you never know how deep it goes
‘Cause if you ever did, it’d be too late to close

So stay on the edge, just ride the line
Some kinds of love are better left undefined

Soft Chorus
‘Cause the best that I am is you
Even when I don’t know what to do
I don’t have much, but I do my best
And every broken part I lose
When I’m standing here next to you
Yeah the best that I am is you

Outro
So maybe never know just how deep it goes
Just know it’s true, and it’s always you
Yeah the best that I am… is you
everybody-poops:
Verse 1
Everybody poops
Everybody poops
Everybody poops in holes
Some covered by porcelain thrones
Some are nothing but dirt and stones

Some seats are heated
Some seats are gold-plated, sanitized and treated
Some don’t have seats, you just gotta squat
That’s just what you got

Chorus
Everybody poops
Everybody poops
From kings in their marble rooms
To kids in their light-up shoes
No matter what you own
You’re still alone
When nature calls the truth

Everybody poops

Verse 2
Not everybody uses toilet paper wipes
Some use water jets
Others use rocks
Some just improvise

Some are terrible
Some are easy
Some are splashy
Some are breezy
Some take time
Some won’t stop
Some you pray just drop

Chorus
Everybody poops
Everybody poops
From penthouse views to camping loops
From fancy spa to forest roots
No matter what you prove
No matter what you choose
We all pay nature’s dues

Everybody poops

Bridge (Deadpan / Spoken style)
It doesn’t care who you are
It doesn’t care what you make
It doesn’t care about your car
Or the promises you break

When the moment comes
There’s no escape

Final Chorus (Bigger but still straight-faced)
Everybody poops
Everybody poops
In silver stalls or muddy boots
It humbles presidents and brutes
You can laugh or you can mope
But there’s no way to elope
From the oldest human truth

Everybody poops
the-magic-man:
**Verse 1**
I’m gonna go see the Magic Man
Ask him what’s waiting there for me
Maybe there’s something past the walls
Something I was meant to be
I saved a little for his hand
He said, “Sit down, let’s have a look”
I thought he’d tell me where I’m going
Like my ending’s in a book
**Pre-Chorus**
Maybe I get out
Maybe I get free
Maybe all this time
There was something meant for me
**Chorus**
I’m gonna go see the Magic Man
About my destiny
He looked me in the eyes and said
“Life is exactly what you expect it will be”
No promised land
No master plan
No secret door, no hidden key
The Magic Man just shook his head
“Life is exactly what you expect it will be”
**Verse 2**
They tell you work and you can have it
They tell you wait and you’ll get your turn
Every door has someone behind it
Deciding what you get to earn
There’s always something in the distance
Just close enough to make you run
Just maybe I can make it out
Just maybe I could be the one
**Pre-Chorus**
Maybe one more year
Maybe one more try
Funny how tomorrow
Keeps a man alive
**Chorus**
I’m gonna go see the Magic Man
About my destiny
He looked me in the eyes and said
“Life is exactly what you expect it will be”
No promised land
No master plan
No secret door, no hidden key
The Magic Man just shook his head
“Life is exactly what you expect it will be”
**Bridge**
So I asked him why we bother
If the walls are built this high
He said, “Hope will keep you walking
Where the truth would make you stop”
I laughed and paid the Magic Man
He smiled and counted three
I guess he makes his living
Selling destiny to me
**Final Chorus**
I went to see the Magic Man
About my destiny
I already knew what he would say
Before he ever spoke to me
No promised land
No master plan
No secret door, no hidden key
He said, “Son, life is exactly
What you expect it will be”
**Outro**
Just maybe I can make it out
Just maybe it could be me
Yeah, maybe.
